claims: The Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) was founded in 1961.
The OECD is based in Paris.
The OECD operates through over 300 committees, working groups, and expert teams.
The OECD's committees, working groups, and expert teams cover areas like economics, education, trade, and environment.
The OECD uses peer reviews and evidence-based analysis to build consensus on policy solutions among member nations.
The OECD focuses on creating international standards for fair taxation, digital development, climate change resilience, financial education, and AI governance.
The United States is an OECD member country.
Japan is an OECD member country.
Germany is an OECD member country.
Canada is an OECD member country.
France is an OECD member country.
Australia is an OECD member country.
South Korea is an OECD member country.
The OECD collaborates with over 70 non-member economies
